read_from: photo 0 (PS logo and PS5 console appearance)

claims.claim: Sony PlayStation 5 console and controller available.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a PS5 console and a DualSense-style controller.

claims.claim: It comes with FIFA disc game and accessories.
claims.evidence: No FIFA disc or FIFA case is visible in photo 0 or photo 1; accessories beyond controller/cables are not clearly shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show seals, warranty stickers, internal inspection, or repair evidence.
Photos cannot confirm overheating behavior or port functionality.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No UK receipt or original packaging/pads are visible in photo 0 or photo 1.

risks.risk: Missing FIFA disc / accessories not included as claimed (or different game).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the FIFA disc (front + back) and a photo showing all included accessories laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Price as PS5 + controller only (no disc, no extra accessories).

risks.risk: Console may be a different PS5 variant or storage size than expected (affects value).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the console model label/serial sticker and the Settings → System → About screen showing storage.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest PS5 comparable shown (worst-case variant/value).

risks.risk: Controller condition (drift, stick wear, button issues) not shown.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing controller connected and testing sticks/buttons (no drift) and charging indicator.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller may need replacement/repair (worst-case).

risks.risk: Ports may not work (HDMI/USB) or console may have faults not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a video booting into the PS5 home screen and showing HDMI output + at least one USB accessory connected.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified working (worst-case: treat as needs testing).

risks.risk: “Never opened” claim could be false; overheating/repairs could exist.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of warranty/void stickers (if any) and a quick internal inspection photo if the seller can provide it.

proof_requests: Photo of the FIFA disc (front + back) and a photo of everything included laid out (receipt/UK paper, cables, any other accessories).
Photo of the PS5 model/serial label and a Settings → System → About screen showing storage size.
Short video: console boots to home screen; show HDMI display and test at least one USB port with a device.
Short video/controller test: show sticks/buttons working (no drift) and charging indicator.
response.reason: The photos confirm a PS5 console and controller, but key items that determine the correct price (FIFA disc/accessories, exact PS5 variant/storage, and verified working/port status) are not shown. Without those, a confident price pick would be unreliable.
